craft_notes: Sthāyin: śṛṅgāra of adornment; vyabhicāri rati at garland re-entered. Sanskrit-first: bhūyas (AGAIN-AND-AGAIN — kept); bhūyāt correction + recovered hemistich per UNC (kept corrected, recorded). Rows: 6 (garland as seal-anchor — whole garland, sequenceless, re-entered), 1 (‘heart-path’ closes — adornment placed last). Close: ‘adorn the heart-path’. Rupture: comma (garland entered, then ray-heaped — entered again, heaped within). Rejected: reverting correction — killed: corrected (recorded); ‘decorate’ for adorn — killed: alaṅkṛ kept adorn (technical). Read aloud: O-WHOLE-gar-LAND, SE-quence-LESS, EN-tered IN-self a-GAIN and a-GAIN … SU-preme, BLISS to-GRASP, EA-ger, NO-ble — GRA-cious TO-me BE-she; a-DORN the-HEART-path.

lines: O whole garland, sequenceless, entered in self again and again,
ray-heaped within without end. Supreme, bliss to grasp, eager, noble — gracious to me be she; adorn the heart-path.
l4.sanskrit_cite: samagrām akṣālīṃ kramavirahitā sātmani muhur | prasannā me bhūyāt hṛdayapadavīṃ bhūṣayatu ca

reads_against.argmap: How enter, and how be adorned? → Garland entered again; gracious heart-path-adornment prayed.
